verdicts.id: stage level and individual level predicates
verdicts.rationale: Same title, but kratzer1988stage is the 1988 Tübingen Genericity conference proceedings version, a distinct publication from the 1995/1996 University of Chicago Press versions (The Generic Book, pp. 125-237). The 1995 and 1996 Chicago Press entries are the same book; the 1988 proceedings is a different work clustered only by title.

kratzer1991conditionals and kratzer1991aconditionals share the DOI and are the 1991 Semantik handbook article. kratzer1986conditionals is Kratzer's 1986 Chicago Linguistics Society 'Conditionals' — a different, earlier paper with no DOI, clustered by title only.
All three entries have identical title, authors, journal, volume/pages, and share the same DOI.
Both entries have identical title, authors, and DOI; one is typed misc but describes the same Neuron article.
Both entries are identical (citekey differs only by a spelling variant of Kriegeskorte); same title, authors, DOI.
Both entries share the DOI and have identical title, author, pages; the odd citekey 'polarity' is just a mislabeled duplicate of the Krifka 1989 nominal reference chapter.
Three identical entries (title, author, journal, volume/pages, DOI) — duplicate citekeys of Krifka 2001 'Quantifying into Question Acts'.

kripke1977speakers and kripke1977speaker share the DOI. kripke1979speakers is the 1979 reprint (Contemporary Perspectives in the Philosophy of Language) of the same Kripke article — same title/author, a reprint of the identical work.
Both entries are identical 'A Puzzle about Belief' with the same DOI, title, author, pages.

ladusaw1994thetic is the 1994 SALT 4 paper (DOI salt.v4i0.2463). ladusaw2000thetic is a distinct 2000 publication in 'Negation and Polarity' (Oxford) with its own different DOI 10.1093/oso/9780198238744.003.0008 — a separate venue/year, clustered by title only.
Both entries are Lakatos 1970 'Falsification and the Methodology of Scientific Research Programmes' in Criticism and the Growth of Knowledge; one lacks the DOI but is the same chapter.

lakoff1970linguistics is the Synthese 1970 journal article (DOI bf00413602). lakoff1971agenerative and lakoff1972linguistics are the 'Semantics of Natural Language' book-chapter version (pp. 545-665), a distinct publication with its own DOI 10.1007/978-94-010-2557-7_19 — different venue, clustered only by title/author.
